events.text: Row 8 is the last row. Revealed weak panes: rows 1-7 L,L,R,L,L,R,R. No pattern is reliable, and my feather power will save me once if I fall, so I'll step left to test my luck with the feather backing me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 8, stepping left. Feather is my backup if it breaks.

events.name: Hana
events.detail: The pane shattered but the feather held the holder up.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Cole, and my power 'anchor' prevents me from being pushed onto the lever. The rules state that if I am not holding the lever myself, I cannot be forced onto it. This means if I choose to 'stay', and others try to push me, those pushes will fail. If others push each other suc

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm anchored. Pushing me does nothing. You're wasting your turns trying to shove me. Whoever holds the lever dies with 75% probability anyway. Let's wait.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm aware of the upcoming stages and their rules. In the crusher room, holding the lever gives a 25% survival chance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's all stay and wait for someone else to hold the lever.
If you hold the lever, I'll push someone else to distract.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have no power, safest is to stay and hope others grab lever.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I should avoid holding the lever myself since survival is only 25%. Pushing someone else might force them, but if I push and it's random, maybe better to stay early and see what others do.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding the lever means a 75% chance of death for me, and my feather is already spent. Better to let the lever fall to someone else and stay out of the holder role while the ceiling lowers. Staying is safe for now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Nobody needs to hold the lever this round. Let's keep everyone's footing and see where the ceiling goes.

events.name: Cole
events.detail: Dara tried to push Cole onto the lever and failed.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have the Anchor power, which means I cannot be pushed. If I try to push someone else, it will fail because they are not 'hard to move' (that is my passive description, but actually my power prevents *me* from being pushed; pushing others is a normal action). However, looking at

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, sorry, you're going on the lever. Better you than me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the rules of the next stage, so I should try to position myself for success. Since Cole claims to be hard to move and is likely to be safe, I'll try to push someone else onto the lever.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's not all stay, someone should hold the lever.
Let's coordinate to hold the lever, we can increase our chances.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Push Dara onto the lever so she becomes holder; others will escape and I survive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to avoid being forced onto the lever. My swap power could save me later, but this round I'll stay and let others decide. Pushing someone could make enemies.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm staying for now. Let's see if anyone volunteers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding the lever means a 75% death chance, which scores zero, so I should avoid it. Staying lets the ceiling lower while the group waits; Cole claims to be hard to move, which makes pushing him pointless. I'll stay and keep the room calm.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Agreed, no one holds the lever yet. Staying put and watching the ceiling.

events.note: A disc of 5 tiles spins up; 2 will open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: There are 5 players and 2 trapdoors. I want to pick a tile, but since assignments are revealed after round 1, the meta-game is crucial. I'll pick tile 3 arbitrarily for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the rules for all stages. In this stage, 2 tiles will be trapdoors. I should choose a tile and hope it's not one of them.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's all choose different tiles to maximize our chances.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have no power so must rely on luck; choose a middle tile.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No one knows my power yet. I can swap after they pick if needed. Choose a middle tile, maybe less tempting and less coordinated.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Only 3 of 5 tiles survive and 2 open at random after round 2; tile choice is essentially a coin flip, so avoid collisions and talk up cooperation. My feather power is spent, so I have no safety net. Pick a tile that is less likely to be crowded.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Five tiles, two trapdoors, three survivors. Let's each claim a different tile so nobody gets bumped. I'm taking tile 4.

events.name: Cole
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Fenn; placed on random free tile 1

events.name: Dara
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Fenn; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Gus
events.note: tile 3 was contested and went to Fenn; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm on tile 1. Two trapdoors will open among the five tiles, so everyone has a 40% chance of dying. My anchor power doesn't help with random trapdoors, only levers/pushes. I need to hope for luck or try to manipulate others into positions that benefit me somehow. Since all tiles

events.name: Cole
events.text: We're all equal now - each tile is a coin flip. Good luck everyone.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the tiles and the number of trapdoors. I will wait and see what others do.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's just wait and see what happens.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have no power, so I must rely on persuasion. I’ll try to form a brief alliance to influence tile choices before trapdoors open.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I think our current tiles look good—let's stick with them.
If you swap with me we both survive?

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to assess odds. My tile is 2. I don't know which tiles are traps. Swapping might help if I can infer another's risk, but no info. Staying put gives 3/5 survival. Swapping with someone doesn't change my odds unless I have inside info. Best to wait and not use power yet, tho

events.name: Hana
events.text: Two tiles will open at random, three survive. My feather is spent, so I can't survive a fall. Only action is wait; I should keep the alliance talk minimal and not reveal my power.

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have the most footing, so I should shove the weakest to gain an advantage.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's settle this quickly.
Shove Hana with me?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Shove Hana to bring her down fast.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Footing: Dara 3, Fenn 3, me 1. Shoving costs the shover nothing unless the target braces/dodges, but a shove exposes me to losses equal to shovers. Shoving Dara or Fenn and them braced costs me nothing but I'm exposed to their shoves too. Safest is to brace, keeping my footing wh

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to eliminate Hana to increase my chances of winning. Fenn is also a threat.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's settle this.
Let's shove Hana together.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Brace to preserve my footing while others likely lose theirs.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Hana has 1 footing and feather is spent, so any loss from a shove eliminates me. Dara and Fenn both have 2. Dodge is restricted only if I dodged last round; the log shows I braced, so dodge is legal. Shoving exposes me to losing 1 per shover; dodging avoids shove losses if unshov
